requirements.requirement:
请用原生课堂生成器创建6至8页、一节8至10分钟的一年级原创课。孩子不能独立读题：场景和多个可区分的图片答案承载意义，目标汉字/数字可显示，其他文字只辅助；每屏一次只做一个任务。操作以点图、拖拽、配对为主，触点至少48px。包含可重玩并改变真实对象或关系的游戏、可观察的错误与正确反馈、三层帮助中最后才演示，以及不同情境的无提示迁移。短句讲解一条一句，与当前图形和聚焦一致。不要emoji、装饰图代替答案，不要在作答前高亮正确选择，不以播放/点击宣称掌握。至少有导入slide、真实interactive和测验任务，控制在8页内；不要预先固定手写页面模板。保留实际四道评测题的身份和原题意，前两道引导、后两道独立，逐题显示，不同时铺满。共用已提供的原创素材，不请求生成图片、TTS、联网或发布。只生成教学页面和actions，不编造孩子成绩、家长报告或已掌握结论。

素材规则：仅传相同src、准确文字描述与清单，不向模型发送图片字节；不使用家庭作业照片。公园图/老师图URL为已存在的StudentWeb本地服务资源，avatars为Native同源资源。若隔离renderer必须同源，runner负责建立仅这些已核对文件的映射并在manifest记实际servedSrc；禁止虚构Native资源路径。数学数量用可核对的SVG物品、盘子或珠子，禁止emoji。公园人物的唯一说话人必须由叠加标记和actions决定，不推定来自底图。
修复后验收约束：情境和每个答案必须使用当前实际支持的原生图片合同，不能用“图片A/头像1/三个点心”等文字假装图片；严格保留冻结题ID，answer仅为options.value，绝不能是label。说听人物造型和头像跨页一致。互动状态要实际可操作、可复位，平台state动作必须能改变真实UI；静态页不可命令孩子拖动。旁白不得提前声称孩子已点过、答对、通关或掌握；仅真实用户事件后的反馈可描述当次操作。错误反馈要说明原因并逐步帮助，不能只变红/摇晃。切换说话人不得当答题计分；知识掌握只能依据明确的无提示首次作答，例题/演示/提示/重复点击不可当独立通过。

至少一个可重玩的实质操作机制，改变对象或关系并给可理解的原因反馈；点一下变颜色、贴纸奖励或翻页不能替代
actions中的讲解对象、数值、说听关系和聚焦目标与实际页面一致，不用浏览器或系统机械语音替代尚未生成的正式音频。实际音色、自动播报与回放验收本轮未测。
生成的学习任务区分示例/引导/提示/独立迁移，提示和演示不得在页面中自称独立掌握；真实后端掌握评分本轮不含。

runtimeProbes.method: Open every scene at1280x720 and1024x768 through actual classroom renderer; record screenshot, DOM, asset decode/load, console/errors and actual48px targets.
runtimeProbes.expected: Every scene usable, with no clipped meaning/options, missing media, uncaught error or pointer block.

runtimeProbes.method: Hide non-target titles/instructions/labels/letters; inspect scene + picture choices while evaluator follows the generated teacher narration transcript. Test visible replay.
runtimeProbes.expected: Scene and choices still distinguish the task. Core transcript test is script-only; actual prerecorded teacher audio is separately required.

runtimeProbes.method: For each of4 locked core questions, run expected value and every distractor on isolated fresh state; inspect submission/grading binding and feedback.

requiredStages.evidenceRequired: source/tests and patch lock, not sample-specific hand edits

requiredStages.criterion: Two native-saved first drafts, frozen inputs and max34 initial calls.
requiredStages.evidenceRequired: per-call receipt, input/hash, output/raw/classroom hashes, all failed/unknown calls included

requiredStages.criterion: All8 hard gates and runtime probes pass per course; independent human review confirms pictures, semantics and feedback.
requiredStages.evidenceRequired: per-scene screenshots/DOM/action traces; objective oracle results; full100 score only after rendered review

requiredStages.criterion: New versioned candidate model-policy preserves old Pro historical hashes; real formal grade/slot/assessment target accepted by both runtime/backend.
requiredStages.evidenceRequired: No invented progressive slot, fake professional receipt, disabled required gate or arbitrary env-only model substitute

requiredStages.criterion: Native isolated formal job genuinely selects/loads required skills and binds final scene contexts; research provenance meets the chosen versioned contract.
requiredStages.evidenceRequired: Current policy mandates search/fetch. Offline verified source reuse needs an explicitly supported new version/provenance contract; no fake fresh fetch or old-session receipt transplant

requiredStages.criterion: Final Stage/Scene passes structural/page/low-reading/grade/oracle/narration checks and independent teaching-quality receipt tied to final snapshot/skills/objectives.
requiredStages.evidenceRequired: actual native receipt with final snapshot, scene hashes, renderChecks and independently issued review; not a manually filled JSON pass

requiredStages.criterion: Actual demonstration→operation→explanatory-feedback→independent-judgment chain and v2 exploration/visual checks pass every locked objective.
requiredStages.evidenceRequired: Native interaction plan plus real two-viewport probes/screenshot hashes; no click-only mastery

requiredStages.criterion: Required images/video, teacher roster and all required Qwen teacher TTS/ASR validations pass with final text/media hashes.
requiredStages.evidenceRequired: Existing audio reusable only with exact approved voice/text/content identity and supported receipt reuse. New TTS/ASR/media consume explicit remaining calls; absence remains required/not_completed

requiredStages.criterion: Server validates generationContract, professional/skill/quality/interaction/media/audio receipts and classroom identity before package/release/student access.

requiredStages.criterion: Existing compatible released courses remain playable/reused, new identity reserves at most one generation; rerunning a request or revisiting lesson does not call AI.

requiredStages.criterion: Only after all required stages and budget checks pass, activate reviewed new default policy for missing/new generation slots; verify managed process model/build identity.
requiredStages.evidenceRequired: Exact config/runtime model readiness, historical Pro receipt preservation and same-course reopen with zero extra generation calls

decision.corePassEffect: Eligible for formal candidate validation, never sufficient alone to switch production model.
decision.formalCandidatePassEffect: Candidate evidence only; final student/audio/cache/publication readiness and new model-policy identity must also pass.
decision.scopeOfFinalSwitch: Validated new generation default only; preserve historical dispatched requests, releases and compatible course reuse.
decision.coverageLimit: 两门一年级小样不是1至6年级全科教学质量保证，也不证明Flash质量优于Pro。
